philosophy.name: Invariant-Relational DCT-Schur Watermarking
philosophy.thesis: Preserve spectral identity, inscribe information in relational degrees of freedom, and use preserved identity as a witness during recovery.

principles.name: Identity before inscription
principles.mathematical_form: T = D + N; preserve D = diag(lambda_1,...,lambda_4)
principles.implementation_rule: Never modify the virtual Schur diagonal; embed only in strict-upper couplings.
principles.real_world_meaning: A media asset should retain a stable structural identity while carrying provenance.

principles.name: Relations carry meaning
principles.implementation_rule: Project relational coordinates onto the nearest parity coset with minimum Frobenius change.
principles.real_world_meaning: Information is carried by relationships among coefficients, not by overwriting isolated pixels.

principles.name: Identity witnesses relation
principles.mathematical_form: omega_i = exp(-((log s_i - median(log s)) / sigma)^2)
principles.implementation_rule: Use unchanged diagonal-derived spectral scale to gate confidence in damaged coupling evidence.
principles.real_world_meaning: The same invariant that was protected during embedding later tells the decoder which evidence to trust.

principles.name: Verify meaning, not resemblance
principles.mathematical_form: valid = ECC decode AND CRC AND digital signature
principles.implementation_rule: Treat NC as a diagnostic metric; accept real payloads only after ECC decoding, CRC validation, and signature verification.
principles.real_world_meaning: A recovered logo that looks similar is weaker evidence than an exactly verified signed record.
